speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: asked the Prime Minister (a) how many of the official websites of Ministries and Statutory Boards meet the WCAG 2.0 or other international standards for website accessibility by persons with disabilities (PWDs); and (b) what steps will be taken to ensure that Government websites are accessible to PWDs to the fullest extent possible.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Prime Minister)
text: It is adopted by various governments around the world, including Singapore.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Prime Minister)
text: WCAG guidelines include the ability to resize websites' text without assistive technology, ensuring a minimum colour contrast ratio and providing captions for videos.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Prime Minister)
text: The websites of agencies are audited for compliance against the standards.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Prime Minister)
text: In addition, some of the CCCs have features, such as elderly-friendly touch screen interfaces and height-adjustable kiosks, for wheelchair users.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
text: I take it that 100% of the Government and Statutory Boards websites are compliant with this standard.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
text: Can we infer that from the Senior Minister of State's answer?

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
text: At the present point in time, 100% of Government and Statutory Board websites are compliant with the WCAG 2.0 standard?

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: On a cyclical basis, we will get through all the agencies' websites.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: If there are any that the Member comes across that are not compliant, please direct them to us and we will help to ensure that they become compliant.
